comment: Core speed budgets (docs/architecture/m3-build-spec.md, m4-build-spec.md and m5-build-spec.md section 8). Read by tools/perf_core.gd, nightly in CI. Never read by a GUT test. A row past its limit fails the job, unless it has a known_over entry (an open issue): then it prints KNOWN OVER and is listed in the report, and the run does not fail. Times are CPU milliseconds, headless; save_mb is the size of the .sav file.

season_ms.what: M7: the thirteen phases of Season.run on the war rig (made-up Europe, 30 wars, armies marching, battles and sieges), worst of 8 seasons (M5: 190, M4: 150; M6: 320 for the army phases; M7: 380, m7-build-spec.md 8)

known_over.note: over the limit on the M4 quiet-machine measure 2026-11-20 and on 2026-11-21 (771 ms, shared machine); see the issue

known_over.note: M4 quiet-machine measure 2026-11-20, see the issue

known_over.note: spikes when works finish, not measured quiet
M5 measure 2026-11-21: 24 ms worst of 8 seasons, machine not quiet (a core season row)
